outcome: volumes of manually expressed colostrum on postnatal days 1, 2, and 3
cohort: Healthy late preterm and term gestational mothers whose babies were roomed in at a tertiary care perinatal setting.
finding: The average volumes of manually expressed colostrum on postnatal days 1, 2, and 3 were 4.68 mL, 8.87 mL, and 22.53 mL respectively, which were comparable to traditional volumes; gestational age and mode of delivery did not significantly affect these volumes, but multiparous mothers expressed significantly higher volumes than primiparous mothers.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not significantly affect the volumes of manually expressed colostrum.
